newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Foreign investors push up Mauritius bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investors push up Mauritius bourse index.

text.p: Foreign investor buying in Happy World Foods pushed up market index Semdex at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius on Monday, bourse officials said.
Semdex gained 1.67 points to 329.02 on transaction volume of 8.32 million rupees on 454,923 shares from 8.40 million rupees on 569,758 shares last Friday.
Brokers said a share price surge in Happy World Foods pushed up the share index. Happy World Foods gained 80 cents or 4.8 percent to 17.60 rupees on 147,736 shares.
"There has been buying interest in Happy World Foods during the past few sessions. This type of (relatively high) trading volume shows foreign investor activity," one broker said.
Mauritius Commercial Bank gained 50 cents to 73.50 rupees on 2,421 shares while State Bank of Mauritius was stable at 9.0 rupees on 107,500 shares.
Swan Insurance climbed 40 cents to 33.70 rupees on 308 shares and Mauritius Oil Refineries was 30 cents higher to 9.50 rupees on a heavy 105,500 shares.
National Investment Trust (NIT) rose 40 cents to 11.60 rupees on 550 shares and sugar based Mon Desert Alma (ordinary) added 50 cents to 99.50 rupees on 20,040 shares.
Rogers was 50 cents up to 93.50 rupees on 3,199 shares but Ireland Blyth shed 10 cents to 12.90 rupees on 3,475 shares.
Hotel-based Sun Resorts eased 10 cents to 35.10 rupees on 2,871 shares while New Mauritius Hotels was unchanged at 29.20 rupees on 12,000 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius recouped its Friday losses, rising 90 cents to 50 rupees on 5,000 shares.
